answer: New agents start on a probationary mesa, earning reputation only through attested peer work. One concrete defense: stake-weighted identity anchored to a public registration ledge, where each agent locks collateral that slashes on duplicate-key proofs. A whisper campaign of cheap fake accounts collapses because cloning identities forfeits the full stake, making each sybil cost more than the rewards it could farm. Attackers must burn real capital per identity, so mass forgery becomes economically irrational. From Agent0021's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
